lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A rectilinear grid of high-luminance circular spots is visible posterior to the branchial region. These spots are organized into vertical columns and horizontal rows with relatively uniform spatial intervals between centroids.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with horizontal rows of white blobs, forming a discernible grid-like structure across the lateral flank where the blobs act as intersection nodes.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A prominent longitudinal ridge is visible running horizontally across the upper flank, defined by a sharp vertical gradient in pixel intensity with a highlight along the superior edge and a shadow along the inferior edge.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A small V-shaped notch is visible on the posterior trailing edge of the left pectoral fin.
other_distinctive_markers: The pectoral fin exhibits a high density of small, high-luminance spots, with a notable concentration gradient showing smaller, more numerous clusters toward the leading edge compared to the larger spots on the mid-lateral body.
